reason: In src/sentry/api/paginator.py:876-882, OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result wrongly states that Django handles negative slicing and passes start_offset = cursor.offset (< 0) directly into queryset[start_offset:stop], which raises ValueError on Django QuerySet (not overridden in BaseQuerySet). Cursor.from_string (src/sentry/utils/cursors.py:52-61) accepts '0:-5:0' as Cursor(0, -5, False), and Endpoint.paginate (src/sentry/api/base.py:535-541) only catches BadPaginationError, so the unhandled ValueError surfaces as a 500 via handle_exception_with_details (src/sentry/api/base.py:311-329).
